name: House Design Tokens (sage default)
description: Single source of truth for design tokens across all surfaces. Edit only files under design/pattern/tokens/, then run build_tokens.py to regenerate design/pattern/generated/. Never hardcode raw values in app code.
winnerRule: Where the shipped code platforms (web globals.css + flutter theme) agree, that value is canonical and overrides the static mock. Web's WCAG-AA variants (*-ink text-on-color, darkened text-tertiary/text-link) are canonical and propagated to flutter. Dark theme is derived from web. Mobile-origin feature colors are preserved (mobile = source of truth for features) and promoted into the token set.
consumers: extension/  (WXT) — reuses generated/tokens.web.css (CSS vars, no re-author)

fonts.delivery: runtime from Google Fonts — mocks: CDN <link>; web: next/font/google; mobile: google_fonts package. Bundle under design/pattern/fonts/ only if offline/perf requires it.

files.color.json: themed semantic colors (core, scale, semantic + ink)
files.color-extra.json: theme-agnostic (identity, video, illustration) + mobile feature colors
files.typography.json: font families, size scale, weights, line-height, letter-spacing
